description_en: Performs a paged query to retrieve the API product subscriptions of a specified HiMarket consumer. The paging process allows you to filter subscriptions by status. Each subscription record includes the subscription ID, the ID, name, and type of the subscribed API product, the consumer ID and name, and the subscription status
description_zh: 分页查询指定 HiMarket Consumer 的 API 产品订阅列表，可按订阅状态筛选，每条订阅返回订阅 ID、被订阅的 API 产品 ID/名称/类型、消费者 ID/名称以及订阅状态
kebab_example: aliyun apig list-hi-market-consumer-subscriptions --consumer-id cs-xxxxxxxxxxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --status APPROVED --max-results 10 --next-token token-xxxxxxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListHiMarketConsumerSubscriptions

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer. The API product subscriptions of this consumer are returned
parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID。返回该消费者的 API 产品订阅列表
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The subscription status used to filter subscriptions. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED
parameters.help_zh: 订阅状态，用于按状态筛选订阅。取值：PENDING、APPROVED
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. The default value and valid values are not specified in the API definition
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数。默认值与取值范围未在接口定义中声明
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. Do not pass this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 以获取下一页，首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

content.description_en: The list of API product subscriptions for the consumer. The list element is named subscription, and each element represents an API product subscription record
content.description_zh: 该消费者的 API 产品订阅列表，列表元素名为 subscription，每个元素为一条 API 产品订阅记录

consumerId.description_en: The ID of the consumer to which the subscription belongs. This is the same identifier as the consumerId path parameter of this API operation
consumerId.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的 ID，与本接口的路径入参 consumerId 同一标识

consumerName.description_en: The name of the consumer to which the subscription belongs
consumerName.description_zh: 订阅所属消费者的名称

productId.description_en: The ID of the subscribed API product, which is the primary ID of the API product resource
productId.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品 ID，即 API 产品资源 Product 的一级 ID

productName.description_en: The name of the subscribed API product
productName.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品名称

productType.description_en: The type of the subscribed API product. This response parameter does not declare enums. The related ListProductSubscriptions API operation declares the following valid values for the parameter with the same name: REST_API, HTTP_API, MCP_SERVER, AGENT_API, and MODEL_API
productType.description_zh: 被订阅的 API 产品类型。本出参未声明 @enums；同族接口 ListProductSubscriptions 对同名出参声明的取值集合为 REST_API、HTTP_API、MCP_SERVER、AGENT_API、MODEL_API

status.description_en: The subscription status. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED. This set of valid values is declared in the enums of the status request parameter in this API operation, and this response parameter does not declare enums
status.description_zh: 订阅状态。取值：PENDING、APPROVED（该取值集合声明在本篇入参 status 的枚举上，本出参未挂 @enums）

subscriptionId.description_en: The subscription ID. You can use this ID to unsubscribe from the product by calling UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct or approve the subscription by calling ApproveProductSubscription. Both operations locate the subscription by using the /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} path
subscriptionId.description_zh: 订阅 ID。可用于 UnsubscribeHiMarketProduct 取消订阅、ApproveProductSubscription 审批订阅，二者均以 /himarket/v1/consumers/{consumerId}/subscriptions/{subscriptionId} 定位该订阅

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries on the current page

nextToken.description_en: The cursor for the next page. An empty value indicates that the last page is reached
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页游标。为空表示已到末页

v1_parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer. The API product subscriptions of this consumer are returned
v1_parameters.help_zh: 消费者 ID。返回该消费者的 API 产品订阅列表
v1_parameters.name: consumerId

v1_parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. The default value and valid values are not specified in the API definition
v1_parameters.help_zh: 每页条数。默认值与取值范围未在接口定义中声明
v1_parameters.name: maxResults

v1_parameters.help_en: The pagination cursor. Pass the nextToken returned in the previous response to retrieve the next page. Do not pass this parameter for the first query
v1_parameters.help_zh: 分页游标。传入上一次响应返回的 nextToken 以获取下一页，首次查询不传
v1_parameters.name: nextToken

v1_parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1
v1_parameters.name: pageNumber

v1_parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
v1_parameters.name: pageSize

v1_parameters.help_en: The subscription status used to filter subscriptions. Valid values: PENDING and APPROVED
v1_parameters.help_zh: 订阅状态，用于按状态筛选订阅。取值：PENDING、APPROVED
v1_parameters.name: status
